title: Another suspect falls in DepEd exec slaying in Zamboanga Sibugay

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Police authorities in Zamboanga Sibugay have arrested the second suspect in the brutal killing of Department of Education (DepEd) supervisor Rey Camaingking, marking another key breakthrough in a case that shocked the local academic community earlier this year. Personnel of the Olutanga Municipal Police Station apprehended the suspect on Wednesday in Barangay Galas, Olutanga, Zamboanga Sibugay. The operation was executed by virtue of a warrant of arrest issued for murder.
